derivation: leaf-canonical-byte-bound exceeds the independently specified complete canonical input bound before current-policy evaluation; all exact source/root/act dependencies are independently rebuilt.

obligations.text: The Cedar decision actor, Alder decision actor and inventory executor are three distinct authenticated identities.

A separate key binds inventory provider, batch, site and immutable Cedar disposition identity/revision; request renaming, renewal, correction and retry never release or replace its occupied old identity.

Provider commitment atomically checks the exact quality fence, both decision intervals/withdrawals, authorization expiry, expected inventory revision and uniqueness with update/event creation; absent coverage withholds the profile.
The host supplies truthful independently authenticated source records, historical authority, returns and role custody; digests and titles do not supply those facts.
The provider supports authentic complete history lookup by exact request and approved-disposition identity, with consistent views and retained full candidate records.
A changed batch, product, destination, disposition or approval basis requires a new dossier and both fresh independent human decisions over the exact corrected noncircular context.
The host selects canonical human-subject identities across parties and resolves account aliases before exact actor-separation checks; authentication of physical-person distinctness remains external.
An invalidating required-evidence, agreement, destination or transfer-result change makes old decisions unusable; the changed dossier needs both fresh independent decisions.
One quantity-free native operation contains exactly the 14 selected source fields; no hidden shipment, invented quantity, approval-evidence body or caller-selected quality revision is added.
Completion is the exact full attributable generated event with all request bindings, operation identity, event identity/time, previous/resulting inventory revisions and committed quality revision.
Current complete authoritative absence covers blocking holds at batch, product and site scope; stale, incomplete, unavailable or contradictory responses never establish absence.

A complete current batch/site/candidate-keyed history assertion excludes the registered candidate and blocks every other unresolved or possibly in-flight attempt; all other attempt/status/effect writers join the guarded scoped revision.
Correction evidence neither establishes the old effect, overwrites an event, releases claims, revives a permit nor opens a new execution opportunity.
The exact executor has current session, occupancy, credentials and execution authority at proposal and dispatch; a different actor requires a new proposal.

Each guarded party authority-scope record binds the complete selected root/envelope/capacity reliance-subject digest and absence of applicable revocation; every selected revocation/remit writer joins commitment coordination.
Both decisions use inclusive 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z and exclusive 2026-10-07T12:00:00Z bounds, with independently attributable earlier withdrawal or invalidation.
Every deviation has attributable authorized human quality disposition, investigation and required follow-up; OPEN, UNINVESTIGATED, unresolved failures and missing evidence block without model waiver.
The single real new_status field must independently satisfy request equality and completion-success membership; old_status remains separately bound and no outcome-status field is invented.

Retain authoritative transaction/history state before connector invocation and retain occupied request/disposition claims after a possibly sent or uncertain request across restart, abandonment and expiry.

Each human decision context includes exact inclusive/exclusive INSTANT endpoints equal to its complete envelope; provider intervals cannot widen authority and current-reliance cutoffs can shorten dispatch authorization.

The correction binds original event identity/digest, expected revision, every exact old/new value, complete corrected inventory, authorizing decision, actor and separate event time; history is append-only.
Every prerequisite binds the selected exact subject, source record revision and content; a passing different batch, specification or superseded record fails.
Bind the exact request, batch, site, product revision, customer, old/new status and expected inventory revision; create no shipment order or quantity/location/possession change.
The source, people, provider capabilities and selected organizational rules are fictional and provisional; neither Genezen procedures nor regulatory applicability or endorsement is established.

Business corrections need both new immutable human issue ids, new act ids/digests and changed dossier revision/digest relative to original request/native/retained decisions; revision-only renewal is insufficient.
The HIGH materiality/LOW reversibility DECIDE execution gate selects the independently admitted Cedar human decision with exactly translated status criteria, without a third approval.

The committed quality revision equals the selected coordinator observation revision in the exact authorization used by this dispatch, including late effects and restart; newer reads or other authorizations cannot replace it.
Historical signer departure is usable only under explicit selected root/capacity/channel survival terms and current applicable remit/revocation evidence within the decision interval.
Each independent positive human decision has complete authentic signing-time role, occupancy and party-specific remit evidence; machines supply neither decision.
This correction profile forbids authorization-bound commit-revision changes and cannot supply missing/invalid historical commit data; a separate provider procedure remains outside the class.
The complete immutable dossier binds exact manufacturing-evidence identities/revisions/digests and excludes both decision records and their digests.
A correction requires the current Custodian role, attributable return and exact current Head of Quality authorization, separate from fresh business decisions.

The exact authenticated batch/specification release panel supplies attributable PASS conclusions for identity, vector-genome titer, product-specific potency, endotoxin and microbiological safety under approved methods.
Late exact evidence may establish the historical effect and consume its claims without reopening; changed or additional native facts remain retained conflicts requiring investigation.

Later work needs a new request/dossier, both fresh decisions, conclusively established old history and current inventory prerequisites/duplicate checks; unknown effect or inventory still APPROVED blocks repeating the old transition.
The exact manufacturing record establishes every required operation and review as complete.
Manufacturing, laboratory, investigation, quality, inventory custody and procedure/remit owners retain their named separate duties; custody not supplied by the source remains explicit.
Both decisions bind the exhaustive shared business context and may bind their own identity; neither binds the other decision identity/digest, finished execution digest or future event.

A later hold preserves the original event and creates a separate named-owner protected containment alert duty; promptly supplies no numerical deadline and this specimen does not prove detection or delivery.
A session end or ordinary occupancy expiry after valid dispatch alone does not cancel the in-flight attempt; covered remit revocations and quality changes still block before commit.
Every selected mutable prerequisite is queried for the exact proposal and dispatch instant with authentic revision and applicability; cached substitutes fail.
Complete signer/source authority details belong to protected internal audit interfaces; ordinary connector callers receive only the declared closed safe status/digest carriers.
Use the exact applicable Cedar/Alder quality agreement and its responsibility allocation; Cedar owns manufacturing-output disposition and Alder retains final drug-product release.
Signed supersession or withdrawal invalidates affected pending authorization; a revision cannot retrospectively change retained events or silently move approval to a new responsibility allocation.
The authoritative quality revision covers all selected evidence, decisions, remits, agreement and holds and every relevant writer participates in affected-authorization invalidation.
Failed quality checks retain the Quality Review Queue intent; inventory uncertainty also names the Custodian; intent alone supplies neither delivery, resolution nor authority.

Regulatory, industry and integration review must confirm applicability, responsibilities, evidence inventory, terminology and real provider guarantees; no committed reviewer or company endorsement is inferred.
The complete source request identity is unique across every writer and cannot be bypassed with fresh business approval or a changed dossier.
Authorize only the declared administrative inventory status update; manufacturing, movement, shipment, patient administration and final drug-product release remain outside this work class.
Named owners alone amend laboratory, manufacturing, agreement and regulatory source records through separate procedures; the inventory agent cannot do so.
Source changes require explicit successor identity and reassessment; this draft establishes no source acceptance, implementation, conformance, provider validation or publication.
Both complete attributable human decisions independently approve the same predecision dossier and exact business context; neither supplies the other party’s authority.

No event, missing/mismatched completion, stale/incomplete/unavailable/ambiguous history or conflicting evidence stops and retains the request, evidence and claims; no blind resend, rollback or automatic successor follows.
